evidence: junk_imagery: seg2:mid (t=24.71s) and seg2:end (t=28.32s) fill the frame with glossy school-building emoji clip-art in a flat editorial look, and in seg2:mid one building renders as a dark garbled cutout with no fill.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: seg2:mid (t=24.71s) and seg2:end (t=28.32s) show a waffle grid of glossy yellow school-building emoji with 'each = 2%', one of them rendering as an unfilled dark cutout; the mascot sits inside the grid covering the final letter of the title, and the bottom 40% of the frame is empty.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The percent-of-teens statistic was routed to a generic icon-waffle machine with an emoji asset dropped in as the unit glyph, so a rate of teenagers is counted out in buildings — a stock pictogram with a topical icon swapped in, not a form made of the subject — and the icon set does not match the flat look, producing clip-art contrast and one broken tile.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Replace the emoji waffle with a depiction made of the subject: 100 teen figures (or a single classroom of silhouettes) with 27.5 of them exhaling a vapour plume and then draining to 7.8, drawn in the channel palette with no raster emoji; fill the frame vertically and keep the title clear of the mascot.
